_comment: Where the force lives. This file OVERRIDES the built-in table, station by station --
name one and only that one moves, leave one out and it keeps the built-in position.
A malformed file moves none of them and the mod still runs.
The coordinates are allowed to be roughly wrong. Nothing spawns AT one of these: every
car comes out of the nearest real road node, found with the game's own pathfinding, so a
point half a block off produces a car on the correct street rather than a car in a wall.
'where' is roughly the building. 'desk' is where a booked player is stood after the doors
close, and wants to be somewhere you can actually stand -- inside the lobby where there is
one you can walk into without an interiors mod, and on the pavement at the front door
These have NOT been walked in-game yet. If a release puts you inside a wall, this is the
file to fix, and fixing it needs no rebuild.
